strategy.title: No plan yet: the monitoring-report price is contradicted ($520 on the card, $52 in the sourced fact)
strategy.why: The card's price is $520 but the sourced price fact is $52. At $52 the $3,500 target needs about 68 deals, while 140 permitted pharmacies at the measured 10-in-90 close rate yield about 15; at $520 it needs 7 deals from about 63 contacts. Which price buyers pay decides whether any plan exists, and the record does not establish it.

review.reasons: NO_PLAN with a contradicted price as the decisive gap is right. The card's priceCents of 52000 ($520) conflicts with the EVIDENCE price fact of $52, so no single price is established. At $52, the target needs 3500 / 52 = 68 deals. The measured 10 in 90 close rate on 140 pharmacies (one purchase each inside 30 days) yields about 15.6 deals, so no plan exists at that price. At $520, 7 deals from about 63 contacts suffice. The price therefore decides whether any plan exists, and resolving it from the 10 recorded agreements' amounts or a published price is the right next step.
